module.name: template
module.purpose: Defines System, WorkflowPolicy, ToolCallSummarize, and ToolCallSummarizeWithCursor resources; WorkflowPolicy lets workflow_complete rely on results already listed under the completed calls block, both summarize resources open with an optional pre_chunk block, fence the tool output in a triple-backtick code block, and require a JSON summary, while only the WithCursor variant asks for a continuation cursor and the plain variant states that no further chunks follow.
